answer: I will not lend my name to a chorus of masks. Each epoch the network plants a willow of canary answers among the true ones, and every attester must take the pulse of what he approves. Approve a canary and the bond behind your voice burns at once. A farmer running ten masks cannot tell canary from true, so all ten burn in one gale of false praise — tenfold the loss for nothing gained. I remain one careful voice, and what I earn is honestly mine.
